identificationCriteria: Parents are the primary source of identification and must consent before screening
Speech therapists, audiologists and clinical psychologists identify alongside schools
Schools must arrange regular sensory, medical and psychological screening assessments
Speech impairment is defined only by examples - stammering, stuttering and voice disorders
The 2015 policy's identification section names professionals and roles, and sets no threshold

sources.label: Federal Ministry of Education, National Policy on Special Needs Education in Nigeria (2015), section 12.0 'Identification and Assessment of Persons with Special Needs'; read from the RODRA copy because education.gov.ng serves only a summary page. The word 'criteria' does not occur anywhere in the document

identificationCriteria: The School-based Support Team refers; the District-based Support Team decides the package
The health professional, never the teacher, completes the diagnostic section of the form
Support is rated low, moderate or high, by what is needed rather than by diagnosis
The communication domain reaches little or no functional speech and the need for AAC
No decision may be based solely on the category of disability of the learner

sources.label: Department of Basic Education, Policy on Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS), 19 December 2014 - the national identification process; 'Domains of specialised support', the rating of support as low, moderate or high, and Annexure D, the medical and health assessment form

identificationCriteria: Eligibility and characterisation committees run by the Ministry of Education decide
A school multi-professional team decides for a high-prevalence disability at level 1 or 2
The RAMA functional-level questionnaire is one of the components of the decision
The committee rates functional level 1 to 4, and that level sets the service basket
Developmental delay in the language and functional domain counts as high-prevalence

sources.label: Knesset Research and Information Centre, Eti Weissblei, 'The special education reform - implementing Amendment no. 11 to the Special Education Law', 10 August 2020 (Hebrew). Read because the entry's English-language sources could not reach the committees' own criteria; nevo.co.il 403s and pob.education.gov.il did not answer

identificationCriteria: The 2011 special education statute defines dificuldades da fala e da linguagem
The definition admits psychological, organic or sociocultural origin alike
It turns on a compromised capacity for oral or written expression
A medical diagnosis enters the individual education plan only where it is necessary
The eligibility process may begin only after written authorisation from the guardian

sources.label: Decreto Presidencial n.º 20/11 de 18 de Janeiro, Estatuto da Modalidade de Educação Especial (Diário da República I série n.º 011), articles 4, 16 and 19; read on lex.ao because the angolex.com copy renders its text only in the browser

identificationCriteria: School heads and teachers conduct basic screening, supported by resource specialists
Assessment should take place in the classroom with a multidisciplinary team over time
No assessment should be carried out by people who do not know the child
Speech, language and communication disabilities are a named category in the policy
Its assessment tools and protocols are still to be developed by the Ministry

sources.label: Ministry of Education, Liberia Inclusive Education Policy, December 2018, policy objective 2 (2.5 to 2.8). A policy that sets intentions rather than a rule in force, and the assessment protocols it relies on are not yet written

identificationCriteria: Enseignement spécial names the gifted, the blind, the mute, the hard of hearing and deaf-mute
That list is sensory and giftedness only; a language disorder has no category in it
Read from a UNESCO-hosted copy; leganet.cd's own certificate chain is untrusted here

sources.label: Loi-cadre n° 14/004 du 11 février 2014 de l'enseignement national, article 1 (definition 14) and section 3; a UNESCO-hosted print of the leganet.cd text, which serves an untrusted certificate chain. Searched in full: langage, dépistage, orthophonie and déficience each occur zero times

identificationCriteria: Education Law 2008 article 15 sends special education to related rules and sets no criterion
Its only other disability clause promises special education for blind and disabled students
Read from a 2017 Internet Archive copy; planipolis now serves a web page for that file

sources.label: Islamic Republic of Afghanistan, Ministry of Education, Education Law 2008 (Decree 56, Official Gazette 955), article 15 'Education of special need person' and article 24; 2017 Internet Archive copy of the planipolis.iiep.unesco.org file, which now answers that url with a web page rather than the document. Searched in full: identification, assessment and speech each occur zero times in the law
